approaches_tried.approach: Ran full `bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh` (no --skip-slow) in the foreground, piped through `tail -60`
approaches_tried.reason: The platform auto-backgrounds any foreground Bash call after ~180s regardless of the tool's requested timeout parameter (tried 560000ms and 500000ms, both still auto-backgrounded at 180s). The `| tail -60` pipe also fully buffered output until process exit, so polling the backgrounded task's output file showed 0 lines throughout. Recognized this also contradicted the dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive (final phase should discharge against a scoped narrowing invocation, not the full gate set), so stopped both the full verify-deploy.sh task and a redundant wait-loop task via TaskStop, and switched to the scoped discharge: `run-all.sh --only test-update-task-status.sh,test-orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh` plus `validate-state.sh --deep` run directly.

deviations.description: Run the complete gate set: verify-deploy.sh (no --skip-slow), run-all.sh in full, validate-state.sh
deviations.reason: Per the dispatch file's '## Batch Gate Deferral' section, this final full-tier phase discharges against a scoped narrowing invocation instead of independently running the complete gate set, with the full sweep deferred once-per-batch to the end of the /orchestrate cycle.
